checks.name: Actual release and English OCR resources are verified before the journey
Normal navigation creates an empty real job while existing matrix and practice are retained
Real OCR associates documented columns; serials/summaries are excluded, duplicates block approval, corrections and unknown Map retain photo provenance
Partial photographs and mismatched expected counts cannot establish full coverage; Map ties do not prove a section; later evidence preserves original snapshots
Recorded timestamps/counters drive deltas; equal coverage can compare, excluded or unknown coverage cannot, quiet is not healthy, resets/raw-only readings retain uncertainty, polls require a source
A corrected device retains its photo and old values; dependent observations are marked for review and explicit review has its own history
Handover preserves an open impairment; recording restoration remains distinct from a cause confirmation or healthy-system certificate
Export includes full provenance/history and explicitly excludes image bytes; import creates an independent job with honest missing-photo notice; other jobs share no device/impairment state
Original photo is atomically saved before OCR, survives an interrupted page, can be cancelled/retried without duplicate identity, and never moves to a different job
Invalid and blank images retain originals with honest recovery; injected photo quota failure remains visibly unsaved, then Retry saves the retained original without duplicating the photo
Phone/tablet/large-touch/reduced-height views fit; saved job and draft resume exactly; separate practice and matrix are unchanged; no page errors
Explicit practice→field deep links persist the chosen site mode through ordinary navigation and reload
